deadline.value: No closing date is given on the Mathematics PhD page.

supervisor.value: Applicants should name a potential supervisor in the application but do not have to contact that supervisor first.

entry_route.value: The minimum is a UK 2:1 in an appropriate subject, and a Master's or MSci will in most cases also be expected.
entry_route.quote: The minimum entry requirement for an MPhil or an MPhil leading to a PhD degree is the equivalent of a UK Second Class Upper Honours degree (2:1) in an appropriate subject. | A Masters degree or an MSci qualification, in most cases, will also be expected.
